headline: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to end Muse AI block
summary: Amazon and Meta are reportedly discussing a deal to end Amazon's roughly two-month block on Meta's Muse AI shopping agent, with talks said to focus on which products Muse can recommend and the potential effect on Amazon's advertising revenue.

claims.statement: Amazon and Meta are reportedly in talks to end Amazon's block on Meta's Muse AI shopping agent.
